insert.tables.pivotTable.from-external-d.note: U:grid/pivot: external data sources need a connection engine gridcraft does not have; hidden.

insert.tables.pivotTable.from-data-model.note: U:grid/pivot: the data model is not in gridcraft; hidden.

tableDesign.tools.summarizePivot.note: U:grid/pivot: translated from gridcraft (table.summarizePivot): opens Create PivotTable with the table as its source.

pivotAnalyze.pivotTable.options.note: U:grid/pivot: checked against gridcraft (pivot.options: Enable show details); the dialog also renames the PivotTable.

pivotAnalyze.activeField.fieldSettings.note: U:grid/pivot: checked against gridcraft (pivot.valueSettings: summarize by, show values as, number format) for the value field under the selected cell.

pivotAnalyze.activeField.drillDown.note: U:grid/pivot: Show Details (pivot.showDetails: the source records behind a value on a new sheet) is not translated yet; hidden.

pivotAnalyze.activeField.expandField.note: U:grid/pivot: checked against gridcraft (pivot.collapse {collapse: false}) for the field under the selected cell.

pivotAnalyze.activeField.collapseField.note: U:grid/pivot: checked against gridcraft (pivot.collapse) for the field under the selected cell.

pivotAnalyze.group.groupSelection.note: U:grid/pivot: gridcraft groups a whole date field (years, quarters, months, days); a selection of items is not grouped separately.

pivotAnalyze.data.changeSource.note: U:grid/pivot: checked against gridcraft (pivot.changeSource: fields missing from the new source are removed).

pivotAnalyze.actions.clear.note: U:grid/pivot: Clear All takes every field out of the PivotTable; Clear Filters shows every item again. Delete PivotTable is pivot.delete.

pivotAnalyze.calculations.olapTools.note: U:grid/pivot: OLAP is not in gridcraft; hidden.

pivotAnalyze.calculations.relationships.note: U:grid/pivot: the data model is not in gridcraft; hidden.

pivotAnalyze.show.fieldList.note: U:grid/pivot: the PivotTable Fields pane (gridcraft pivot_pane.rs), as a view flag.

pivotDesign.layout.subtotals.note: U:grid/pivot: checked against gridcraft (pivot.subtotals: none, top, bottom).

pivotDesign.layout.grandTotals.note: U:grid/pivot: checked against gridcraft (pivot.grandTotals: off, on, rows, columns).

pivotDesign.styles.gallery.note: U:grid/pivot: checked against gridcraft (pivot.style: PivotStyleLight1 to 28, Medium and Dark); every style is drawn as a tile under its Light, Medium or Dark heading.

tableDesign.tools.insertSlicer.note: U:grid/slicer: checked against gridcraft (table.insertSlicer): opens Insert Slicers for the table.

slicer.slicer.caption.note: U:grid/slicer: the caption box of the tab shows the selected slicer's header caption and Enter sets it (gridcraft Slicer.caption).

slicer.buttons.columns.note: U:grid/slicer: checked against gridcraft (Slicer.columns, 1 to 10 tile columns).

slicer.actions.delete.note: U:grid/slicer: checked against gridcraft (slicer.delete, which also clears the filter it set).

dialog.createPivotTable.note: U:grid/pivot: Excel's Create PivotTable over gridcraft's insert.pivotTable (source, new sheet at A3 or an existing cell).

fields.label: Choose where you want the PivotTable to be placed

dialog.changePivotSource.note: U:grid/pivot: Excel's Change PivotTable Data Source over gridcraft's pivot.changeSource.

dialog.pivotGrouping.note: U:grid/pivot: Excel's Grouping for a date field over gridcraft's pivot.group (one level: days, months, quarters or years).

dialog.pivotTableOptions.note: U:grid/pivot: Excel's PivotTable Options (name, enable show details) over gridcraft's pivot.options.

dialog.valueFieldSettings.note: U:grid/pivot: Excel's Value Field Settings over gridcraft's pivot.valueSettings: Custom Name, Summarize Values By, Show Values As, Number Format. Drawn by src/apps/grid/dialogs/valueFieldSettings.tsx.

fields.label: Number Format (leave empty for the source's)

dialog.insertSlicers.note: U:grid/slicer: Excel's Insert Slicers over gridcraft's insert.slicer, drawn by src/apps/grid/dialogs/insertSlicers.tsx.

dialog.slicerSettings.note: U:grid/slicer: the slicer's header caption (gridcraft Slicer.caption); Excel's sorting and hiding options are not in gridcraft.
